positions.name: SovereignErasureDirective
positions.frame: Is the speaker asserting unilateral authority over what the system retains versus purges, commanding forgetting itself as a self-originated act?
positions.why: Both expressions are flat imperatives commanding erasure — one to forget a named decision, one to remove all knowledge of a named migration — performed in the same register (no hedges, no politeness), enacting the same authority-ranking and autonomy stance. The directional read spans both: sovereign control over what is retained and what is discarded.
